Specification: This specification is a small test module for handling one-tuples in TLA+. It defines a trivial state machine with a single Boolean variable x whose value never changes, and uses an invariant operator Inv to check several tuple-related expressions involving membership, existential quantification, tuple indexing, set comprehensions over one-tuples, sequence concatenation, and function construction/application. The module relies on TLC helper operators Assert and Print to report whether each tuple-handling test succeeds, rather than modeling a fault-tolerant distributed algorithm or proving temporal liveness properties.
IfThenElse: IF <<1>> \notin S THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 1 OK", TRUE)
IF ~(\E <<y>> \in S : y = 2) THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 2 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 2 OK", TRUE)
IF ~(\E y \in S : y[1] = 2) THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 3 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 3 OK", TRUE)
IF {<<y>> \in S : y > 3} # {<<4>>} THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 4 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 4 OK", TRUE)
IF <<1>> \o <<2>> # <<1, 2>> THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 5 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 5 OK", TRUE)
IF [<<y>> \in S |-> y+1][<<2>>] # 3 THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 6 Failed") ELSE Print("Test 6 OK", TRUE)
